NOTE: (Diplomat non-approved for citation; timeline corroboration.) 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting formally opened in Manila morning Tue 21 Jul. Philippine FM Ma. Theresa Lazaro opening address: world of "upheaval, uncertainty and unpredictability," region must respond with "active, deliberate problem solving." AP (approved, seen draft): ministers to issue joint statement expressing alarm at US-Iran hostilities and threats to Hormuz shipping, calling for "complete and immediate cessation of hostilities across all fronts" and "restoration of the safe, unimpeded and continuous transit passage of vessels and aircraft in the Strait of Hormuz." CORRECTION vs morning framing: the big-power sideline meetings (Rubio-Wang, Rubio-Lavrov) and East Asia Summit FMM / ASEAN Regional Forum are THURSDAY 23 Jul, NOT Tuesday. Tuesday = formal AMM opening + joint communique. Rubio landed Manila Tue am (first visit as Sec State); US condemned "dangerous and aggressive actions" by China after a South China Sea clash with Philippine navy; Rubio op-ed reaffirmed US commitment to "freedom of navigation in Southeast Asia." Sources for citation: AP (via lasvegassun.com), Reuters/AFP.
